# Meal Plan

## Breakfast
- 2 scrambled eggs
- 1 slice of whole wheat toast
- 1/2 cup of sliced strawberries
- 1 cup of black coffee

Total Calories: 300

## Snack 
- 1 medium apple
- 1 oz of almonds

Total Calories: 220

## Lunch
- Grilled chicken breast (4 oz)
- 1/2 cup of quinoa
- 1 cup of mixed veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots)
- 1 small orange

Total Calories: 415

## Snack 
- 1 cup of nonfat Greek yogurt
- 1/2 cup of blueberries

Total Calories: 120

## Dinner
- Baked salmon (4 oz)
- 1 cup of brown rice
- 1 cup of roasted Brussels sprouts
- 1 small peach

Total Calories: 470

## Total Caloric Intake: 1,525 calories

# Workout Plan

## Monday: Cardio and Strength Training
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes of light cardio)
- Run on treadmill (30 minutes, moderate intensity)
- 3 sets of squats (12-15 reps)
- 3 sets of lunges (12-15 reps)
- 3 sets of push-ups (10-12 reps)

Total Caloric Burn: 350 calories

## Tuesday: Yoga
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes of stretching)
- Sun Salutation A (5 rounds)
- Sun Salutation B (5 rounds)
- Warrior I, II, III (3 sets of 10-15 breaths)
- Cooling down (5-10 minutes of stretch)

Total Caloric Burn: 200 calories

## Wednesday: Interval Training
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes of light cardio)
- 30-second sprint (maximum effort)
- 90-second rest (light jog)
- Repeat for 10-15 intervals
- Cool-down (5-10 minutes of stretch)

Total Caloric Burn: 400 calories

## Thursday: Rest Day

## Friday: Cardio and Strength Training
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes of light cardio)
- Row machine (30 minutes, moderate intensity)
- 3 sets of deadlifts (12-15 reps)
- 3 sets of bench press (10-12 reps)
- 3 sets of dumbbell curls (10-12 reps)

Total Caloric Burn: 350 calories

## Saturday: Pilates
- Warm-up (5-10 minutes of stretching)
- The Hundred (3 sets of 100 breaths)
- The Roll Up (3 sets of 10-12 reps)
- The Plank (3 sets of 30-60 seconds)
- Cooling down (5-10 minutes of stretch)

Total Caloric Burn: 200 calories

## Sunday: Rest Day

## Total Caloric Burn: 1500 calories (average for 6 days)

## Total Caloric Intake: 1,525 calories
